title: RAIA Viewing Request
description: Viewing request and confirmation for a RAIA property. The buyer agent proposes up to three slots; the estate agent confirms one. A viewing request advances the parent enquiry (see enquiry.json) from IDENTIFIED to DATA_GATHERING, and to AWAITING_HUMAN_ASSERTION where the estate agent's policy requires human approval before the slot is confirmed.

viewing_id.description: UUID v4 assigned by the estate agent's system when the viewing request is created. Immutable.

raia_version.description: RAIA Protocol version. Must match the parent enquiry's raia_version. Format: MAJOR.MINOR.

enquiry_id.description: The enquiry this viewing request belongs to. Viewing requests never exist outside an enquiry.

proposed_slots.description: Up to three slots proposed by the buyer agent.

confirmed_slot.description: Exactly one of proposed_slots, chosen by the estate agent. Required when state is CONFIRMED.

confirmed_at.description: When the estate agent confirmed the slot. Required when state is CONFIRMED.

decline_reason.description: Why the request was declined or cancelled. No personal data.

notes.description: Access or logistics notes. Never carry L1+ personal data here.

expires_at.description: After this time an unconfirmed request moves to EXPIRED.

metadata.description: Optional implementation-specific metadata. Never use metadata to carry L1+ personal data.

ViewingEnquiryState.description: The parent enquiry's state at the time of this message. Mirrors the enquiry.json state machine.
